lead: Built with CSS scroll snapping and nothing else. The element stays one row tall however many cards it has, so a long feature list fits on a short page.

items.title: Snap points, no script
items.text: The browser handles dragging, momentum and keyboard scrolling.

items.title: The row can take focus
items.text: Keyboard users can scroll it with the arrow keys.

items.title: Compact makes cards narrower
items.text: More cards are visible at once, but each has room for less text.

items.title: The next card shows at the edge
items.text: A card cut off at the edge tells readers there is more to scroll.
